name: tulman

attributes.attribute: names the palace inside a fairy mound

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tulman is a Scottish folkloric term. It describes the palace inside a fairy mound. In Scotland the word names the inner dwelling that the fair folk keep within the hill.

okr.objective: Record the Scottish folkloric term tulman.
key_results: It describes the palace inside a fairy mound
The word is used in Scotland for the fairy dwelling
